videos.title: Cirque du Soleil: Volta
videos.description: Using daring acrobatics, Cirque du Soleil creates a visually striking world to tell a story about the freedom to choose and the thrill of blazing one's own trail, inspired by the culture of action sports.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: The captain of an aeroplane carrying some VIP passengers has to deal with a mysterious hijacker, who demands a ransom and seemingly vanishes into thin air before the plane lands.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: At the height of her fame, Myra, a fashion model, is suddenly out of favour with her agency and deserted by her boyfriend, but she sees an opportunity to win him back years later.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: A wife embarks on the path to disaster when the seeds of jealousy are planted in her mind after overhearing a woman and a man with the same name as her husband discussing a trip to Paris.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: Wanting to prove their safes are impregnable, a company challenges ex-safe-breaker Sam to crack one for a cash prize as a publicity stunt, and the retired thief is determined to get his money's worth.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: Ten years after he was a young soldier billeted in Paris at the end of World War Two, Robert Simpson returns to the house where he stayed, owned by resistance hero Hector Vareille.

videos.title: Alfred Hitchcock Hour
videos.description: Everything's coming up roses for newlyweds (Patrick O'Neal, Kathie Brown) using the garden as a graveyard for blackmailers.

videos.title: Alfred Hitchcock Hour
videos.description: An ethical lawyer becomes very disturbed about what to do when the client he just got acquitted of murder brags that he committed the crime.

videos.title: Opry Live
videos.description: Jordan Davis, Hudson Westbrook, Graham Barham, Avery Anna and Emily Ann Roberts bring live country music to the Grand Ole Opry stage.

videos.title: Downhill Racer
videos.description: An aloof ski bum feels inclined to race in the Olympics when the top-ranked skier is injured on the slopes.

videos.title: Rod Stewart: It Had to Be You
videos.description: Featuring live renditions of songs from 'It Had to Be You: The Great American Songbook' and nine of Rod Stewart's own classics.

videos.title: Portrait Artist of the Year
videos.description: Nine artists paint food critic Grace Dent or comedians Munya Chawawa and Grace Campbell. Who will claim the final semi-final place?

videos.title: Dusty Springfield Live at the Royal Albert Hall
videos.description: Filmed at the Royal Albert Hall in 1979, this film captures Britain's greatest pop diva at the height of her career. The show is packed with hits from across Dusty's career, including 'I Only Want to Be with You', 'Wishin' and Hopin", 'The Look of Love', 'Son of a Preacher Man' and many more, delivered with all the glitz and panache that were her trademark.

videos.title: Tina Turner: Live in Holland
videos.description: 'The Queen of Rock and Roll' performs hits including Steamy Windows, Private Dancer, What's Love Got to Do with It and Goldeneye to a crowd of 35,000 at Holland's Gelredome Stadium.

videos.title: The Beach Boys: Good Vibrations Tour
videos.description: In 1976, the five original members of the Beach Boys gathered to perform at Anaheim Stadium, featuring hits including 'Good Vibrations', 'Surfin' USA', and 'It's OK'.

videos.title: Muddy Waters and the Rolling Stones: Live at the Checkerboard Lounge
videos.description: On 22 November 1981, in the middle of their mammoth American tour, the Rolling Stones arrived in Chicago prior to playing three nights at the Rosemont Horizon. Long influenced by the Chicago blues, the band went to Buddy Guy's club to see the legendary Muddy Waters perform. This unique occasion was captured on camera and has now been restored from the original footage.

videos.title: Eric Clapton: Across 24 Nights
videos.description: Highlights from Eric Clapton's record-setting run at The Royal Albert Hall in 1990-1991, where he performed hits spanning his entire career over 24 consecutive sold-out nights.

videos.title: The Great Songwriters
videos.description: Brit Award winner Tom Odell discusses his songwriting, reflects on his life in music, and performs a selection of his tracks, including 'Another Love' and 'Grow Old with Me'.

videos.title: Classic Albums
videos.description: Arguably the first supergroup, Cream featuring Ginger Baker, Jack Bruce, Eric Clapton, lyricist Pete Brown, artist and lyricist Martin Sharp, producer Felix Pappalardi and legendary engineer Tom Dowd, achieved massive worldwide success and ensured their place in rock's hall of fame with `Disraeli Gears' in 1967. With interviews musical demonstration, acoustic performance and archive footage.

videos.title: The South Bank Show
videos.description: Melvyn Bragg talks with Carlos Acosta, a Cuban ballet dancer who performed across the world and was a permanent member of The Royal Ballet for over a decade.

videos.title: All Rise: Edinburgh International Festival
videos.description: Wynton Marsalis brings All Rise to the stage, a thrilling celebration of jazz and blues performed by more than 200 musicians.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: An eccentrically dressed stranger gets off a train and, within just a few days, has endeared himself to the citizens of the town with his jovial behaviour and magical tricks as Sir Columbus.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: Edward and his friend George desperately need money and scheme up a daring bank robbery with the help of a professional crook, but things do not go according to plan when they miss a crucial notice on the door.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: When a man is murdered in a park, Constable Mary Bryan finds herself tasked with acting as bait to catch the suspected killer, but she could be tracking the wrong man.

videos.title: Inside The Music
videos.description: Step inside the rehearsal room with the London Philharmonic Orchestra as conductors Edward Gardner and Karina Canellakis explore Mahler's symphonies.

videos.title: Classic Movies: Iconic Scenes
videos.description: This central scene encapsulates Alfred Hitchcock's concept of situating the story wholly from the place and perspective of a man who cannot do anything about it.

videos.title: Portrait Artist of the Year
videos.description: Nine artists paint food critic Grace Dent or comedians Munya Chawawa and Grace Campbell. Who will claim the final semi-final place?

videos.title: Andre Rieu: Romantic Paradise
videos.description: The charismatic violinist and his Johann Strauss Orchestra serenade their audience in Cortona with a magical and starlit performance that includes 'Rota's Love Theme' from 'The Godfather'.

videos.title: Classic Artists: Jethro Tull
videos.description: The fascinating story of Jethro Tull, the classic rock band from Luton responsible for such classic hits as Aqualung, Living in the Past and Thick As a Brick.

videos.title: Les Misérables: The Staged Concert
videos.description: A live broadcast of the musical phenomenon Les Misérables, filmed from London's Gielgud Theatre in celebration of 35 years on the West End.

videos.title: The Assassination Bureau
videos.description: In 1906, a secret international club eliminates those they deem unworthy. Their leader, in an attempt to rejuvenate the group, challenges his assassins to target him, while he in turn will attempt to assassinate them. The scene is set for a cat-and-mouse chase across Europe, which is further complicated by the presence of a beautiful female reporter.

videos.title: Legends In Concert: Johnny Cash
videos.description: Fantastic collection of recordings from Johnny Cash's early years, including nostalgic performances of I Got Stripes, Don't Take Your Guns To Town and Five Feet High And Rising.

videos.title: Opry Live
videos.description: Lainey Wilson, Vince Gill, Paul Franklin and Switchfoot bring live country music to the Grand Ole Opry stage in Nashville, Tennessee.

videos.title: Gloria Gaynor: I Will Survive
videos.description: Music legend Gloria Gaynor overcomes traumatic events and rebuilds her life. She invests her own resources to produce a gospel album that wins her a second Grammy award.

videos.title: Chic And Nile Rodgers: Jazz A Vienne
videos.description: Disco legends Chic and Nile Rodgers perform hits including Everybody Dance, Le Freak and Good Times at the 2013 Jazz Vienne music festival in France.

videos.title: Discovering Music
videos.description: Music journalists examine the life and music of Michael Lee Aday, better known as Meat Loaf, the larger-than-life singer-songwriter behind anthemic hits like 'Bat Out of Hell' and 'I'd Do Anything for Love'.

videos.title: The Great Songwriters
videos.description: The Waterboys' frontman talks songwriting and his life in music, and performs a selection of the band's tracks including 'The Whole of the Moon'.

videos.title: Classic Albums
videos.description: The story behind Deep Purple's 1972 album 'Machine Head', a defining sound of an era that featured the hit song 'Smoke on the Water' and one of the most recognised riffs in rock music.

videos.title: A Swan Lake
videos.description: In 'A Swan Lake', choreographer Alexander Ekman's new full-length work created for the Norwegian National Ballet, the dancers are joined on stage by actors, a soprano, musicians and 1,000 rubber ducks.

videos.title: Artist of the Year: Masterclass
videos.description: In this first masterclass, Artist of The Year judge Tai-Shan Schierenberg will be introducing one of the most essential principles of painting, how to observe and understand tone.

videos.title: Artist of the Year: Masterclass
videos.description: Alla prima painting is tricky, but Sara Reeve has you covered. Her joyous explanations are just what you need to master the technique.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: Edward and his friend George desperately need money and scheme up a daring bank robbery with the help of a professional crook, but things do not go according to plan when they miss a crucial notice on the door.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: When a man is murdered in a park, Constable Mary Bryan finds herself tasked with acting as bait to catch the suspected killer, but she could be tracking the wrong man.

videos.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
videos.description: A woman grows suspicious when her fiancé continually postpones meetings with his mother with excuse after excuse for why she cannot see her, leading to the unravelling of a hidden secret.

videos.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
videos.description: A man is told he has to retire from his job at the jewellery store where he has worked most of his life.

videos.title: Alfred Hitchcock Hour
videos.description: After his son's murder, a zealot (R.G. Armstrong) becomes obsessed with capturing the killer. With Dick York.

videos.title: Discovering Film
videos.description: An in-depth look into the career of the versatile Academy Award-winning actor Nicolas Cage, known for his wide variety of roles in films like 'Leaving Las Vegas', 'The Rock', and 'Raising Arizona'.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: When Keith Briscoe's ex-wife seems in danger from a sadistic killer, he realises how much he still loves her, but Elaine, his second wife, is not going to make divorce easy.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: When her best friend Liz tells her that her husband George is having an affair with the much younger Carol, Mary Hitchman decides to meet her rival and invites her to a civilised beach party.

videos.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
videos.description: A young man lives a life of excess that leads him into considerable debt and a desperate scheme to fix his financial woes by speeding up the inheritance of his rich uncle's estate.

videos.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
videos.description: A burglar finds himself bargaining with one of his victims when he discovers that committing a robbery will not be nearly as profitable as collecting on a lucrative life insurance policy.

videos.title: The Eighties
videos.description: A look at how the personal computer, the internet and video games all became part of daily life thanks to innovations made during the 1980s.

videos.title: Discovering Film
videos.description: A look at the glittering career, achievements, and life of the multi-award-winning British actor Jeremy Irons, whose films include 'Reversal of Fortune', 'The Man in the Iron Mask', and 'The Lion King'.

videos.title: Landscape Artist of the Year
videos.description: The contestants head to Sussex's Herstmonceux Castle, hoping to capture the historic splendour of one of the oldest buildings still standing in Britain.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: An employee successfully manages to defraud his company, but then an accountant discovers his secret.

videos.title: Tales of the Unexpected
videos.description: Tired of gloves vanishing from his factory, Ralph hires a detective. Then, when he tells his wife about the thefts, gloves start appearing in unexpected places.

videos.title: Alfred Hitchcock Hour
videos.description: A woman (Pilar Seurat) becomes the target of her murderous spouse after finding a victim's button.

videos.title: Andre Rieu: World Tour
videos.description: Join Dutch violin sensation André Rieu as he dazzles audiences at some of the most historic venues around the world.

videos.title: Classic FM Live: Music Of The Planets
videos.description: Witness a musical journey through the stars with space-inspired favourites performed by the Philharmonia Orchestra at Royal Albert Hall.

videos.title: All Rise: Edinburgh International Festival
videos.description: Kemençe master Derya Türkan assembles a stellar line-up to bring 17th-century Constantinople to life at The Hub, Edinburgh.

videos.title: LSO: Rattle Conducts Sibelius & Bruckner
videos.description: Sir Simon Rattle conducts Sibelius' tone poems and Bruckner's radiant Seventh Symphony, where vast landscapes merge with the human soul.

videos.title: Dangerous Debussy
videos.description: Follow the complicated life of Debussy, whose turbulent private life hid behind his compositions, through his relationships with the women who loved and supported him.

videos.title: The South Bank Show
videos.description: Melvyn Bragg talks with Carlos Acosta, a Cuban ballet dancer who performed across the world and was a permanent member of The Royal Ballet for over a decade.

videos.title: The Directors
videos.description: A glimpse into the life and career of the filmmaker whose portfolio of work includes 'Vera Cruz, The Big Knife, The Dirty Dozen and The Longest Yard'.
